review_kind: Internal scientific and source-scope review by a separate delegate; not qualified external peer review or independent experimental replication.
reviewer_role_boundary: Reviewer independently checked BSINC primary-method claims and the combined synthesis, and contributed the source-grounded synthetic-rDNA assessment and correction/deposit checks. The synthetic section is not claimed as wholly independent of its contributor.

checks.finding: PASS: commercial theoretical genome-copy inputs and DNA mass/defined dilution inputs remain author-reported calibration quantities; no independently certified stock or viable-cell denominator asserted. Sanger sequence identity is distinguished from absolute quantity.

PASS: BSINC standard is pre-extracted DNA separately barcoded from sample extract; synthetic DNA was added post-extraction or post-lysis. Neither entry establishes pre-entry cell recovery or native mutation-origin survival. Remaining DNA/sequence/processing transfer is explicit.
PASS: genome copies, rRNA gene/operon copies, cells, viable cells and mutation births remain distinct. dPCR 16S-to-genome mapping has not been replayed.

PASS: identifiable calibration parameters, propagated joint uncertainty, justified transfer and pre-evaluation freeze are required. The package neither prohibits separate calibration fitting nor calls endpoint-derived scale an independent predictor.

PASS: library barcodes and technical replicates are not authenticated biological units; synthetic assessment retains shared-pool dependence and rejects reading pairwise contrasts as independent trials. No native count law is admitted.
PASS: BSINC dPCR shares purified DNA with sequencing; corroboration is scoped downstream and author-reported. Shared extraction and gene/genome mapping limitations remain explicit.

PASS: acquired date-only correction is distinguished from scientific measurement correction. Deposited archives have advertised sizes/checksums only; no archive-byte authentication, source counts or code replay claimed. SRA summary/validation correspondence remains unresolved without alleging source error.

PASS: all 15 BSINC selected anchors and all 7 synthetic selected anchors found in retained primary-text representations. Correction wording and the three-file Zenodo metadata were inspected directly; checks validate representations, not experimental truth.
PASS: no native panel, stock, calibration record, event count, biological fit or theorem admitted; all 26 study and 18 planning values remain NULL; frozen model and methods boundaries maintained.

PASS: reviewed package contains concise derived source facts and public record metadata. Private local inventory, private-file fingerprints, source bodies, provider identifiers and author contact details stay external; no archive- or patent-use license is inferred.

approval_scope: Scientific/source-scope package ready for root integration and exact-commit publication review; integrity verifier must be rerun after review/checksum refresh.
